verdict.label: Instant
verdict.oneLiner: Self-serve: a public integration works without review; Integration Gallery listing is a separate review.

requirements.label: Notion account with workspace owner rights

steps.title: Decide public or internal integration
steps.detail: Only a public integration supports OAuth for other workspaces.

steps.title: Create a public integration
steps.detail: Open the integrations page, create an integration, switch it to Public and fill the required company details.

steps.title: Add the redirect URI
steps.detail: Register your callback exactly as your app sends it.
steps.agentAction: Generate the callback URL for dev and prod hosts.

steps.title: Run the OAuth flow
steps.detail: Authorize from your own workspace, pick pages to share, exchange the code.

steps.title: Connect from a second workspace
steps.detail: This settles whether public OAuth needs a review (see uncertainties).

blockers.cause: The authorization code was reused or expired before the token exchange.
blockers.fix: Exchange the code once, immediately after the redirect.
